'''Vylanthar Merric''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Merric was raised on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was favored by [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]] and while still a youth, Merric was brought to the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Merric initially sought to become an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]], but the noble's enthusiasm for the Empire began to wane after Merric began to move in more select circles and learned of the various atrocities that the Empire regularly committed. Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the Empire in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Merric left the court and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Merric became a crew member aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Griffon's Wings]]'' and he served as part of an Alliance [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] team that was assigned to search for new plants on which the Alliance could build secret bases.

A short time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' was dispatched by the Alliance to explore the planet [[Yorgraxx]]. However, after arriving in the [[Yorgraxx system/Legends|Yorgraxx system]], the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' was attacked by three Imperial [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruiser]]. The transport was forced to crash-land on Yorgraxx and the impact knocked Merric and the rest of the vessel's crew unconscious. After coming around, Merric and the surviving crew encounted [[Arran Flekk]] and [[Vor Harkass]], two Imperial scouts that were stranded on Yorgraxx, and the pair agreed to work with the crew of the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' to find a way off of Yorgraxx. Shortly afterward, the group investigated a nearby [[Fornayh's fortress|Sith fortress]], where they encounted the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]] and the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Jallar Golin]].

==Personality and traits==
Merric did not hate the Galactic Empire, but instead feared it and reasoned, on an intellectual level, that the Empire could not be allowed to continue to exist. Merric was [[Language/Legends|multi-lingual]] and was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bothese]], [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]], [[Durese/Legends|Durese]], [[Geonosian (language)/Legends|Geonosian]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|Kel Dor]], [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]] and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]]. In addition, Merric understood [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] and knew how to read and write the [[Sith (language)|Sith]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vylanthar Merric was created by [[Robert Wiese]] and appears in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'', as a pre-generated character that a player of the adventure can choose to role-play as. The players have the choice of determining whether Merric has a [[Gender/Legends|male]] or female gender, and the character's [[canon]] gender is not revealed.
